description: Unit upgrade tracks: what each level from 1 to maxLevel changes (requirements §4.7; D135, D136, D142, D150, D151, D157-D162). Copies of an item share its level, and levels are fixed at match start (D149). Health never rises and combat characters never gain range. Levels only apply from rules version 2; older records replay without them.

maxLevel.description: Highest unit level. Every level table below has exactly this many rows, one per level from 1.

deployCost.description: Deploy cost by level (D151): cost x (100 + percentPerStep x (level - 1)) / 100, rounded half up, then raised to at least the cost plus the highest minimum raise reached. Bases stay free.

percentPerStep.description: Percent added to the deploy cost for each level above 1.

minimumRaises.description: Minimum points a unit costs above its level 1 cost once it reaches the given level, so cheap units' upgrades are never free (20 -> 21, 22, 23, 24; 8 -> 8, 9, 9, 10).

characters.description: Character tracks by role (D135, D136). Attackers hit harder, Defenders take less damage, Healers and Engineers support more; Boosters and Cleansers gain reach and targets instead.

attackPercentPerStep.description: Attacker characters (Fire, Ice, Poison): attack percent added for each level above 1, alongside the base bonuses (+24% at level 5).

damageTakenPercentPerStep.description: Defender characters (Earth, Water, Metal): damage taken is multiplied by this percent for each level above 1, worked out exactly and rounded once (x0.81 at level 5).

supportPointsPerStep.description: Healer and Engineer characters: points added to every heal, repair and revive share for each level above 1 (Heal 30/40/50% -> 32/42/52% at level 2).

booster.description: Booster character by level: extraRange is added to its range, allies is how many allies one Boost reaches (D136).

cleanser.description: Cleanser character by level: allies is how many allies one Cleanse reaches, effects is how many effects it removes from each (0 removes every effect). A partial Cleanse removes Chill first, then the effect that would still deal the most damage (D136, D142).

towers.description: Tower tracks, one per tower (D150). Each row is the tower's whole bonus at that level, not the change from the level before.

mainEffectPercent.description: Percent added to the tower's own job (D142): attack for Attacker and Defender towers; for Healer and Engineer towers the heal or repair share is multiplied by (100 + this) / 100, rounded once (D158).

fireCostReduction.description: Durability points taken off the fire cost (never below 0).

extraRange.description: Spaces added to the tower's range.

allies.description: Booster and Cleanser towers only: how many allies one action reaches (1 if left out).

effects.description: Cleanser tower only: effects removed from each ally, 0 for every effect (every effect if left out).

tracks.description: Attacker tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Attacker tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Attacker tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Defender tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Defender tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Defender tower: +8% attack at levels 2 and 4, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Healer tower: heal share x1.08 at level 2 and x1.16 at level 4 (D158), fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Engineer tower: repair share x1.08 at level 2 and x1.16 at level 4 (D158), fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5.
Booster tower: range +1 at level 2, 2 allies at level 3, fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5; level 4 adds nothing new (range +2 and 2 allies in all, D159).
Cleanser tower: follows the Cleanser character for levels 2-4 (2 effects, 2 allies, every effect), fire cost -1 at level 3, range +1 at level 5; never more than 2 allies (D142).

bases.description: Bases by level (D157): matchingTypeBonusPoints is added to the matching-type bonus (10% -> 20% at level 5, 2.5 points per level rounded half up); roleBonusPoints is added to the percentage role bonuses (Attacker base attack, Healer base heal, Defender base repair). Whole-number role bonuses (Engineer AP discount, Booster extra tier, Cleanser poison turns) don't change.
